basis: Research requirements compared against released data and source definitions; no private correspondence reproduced.
overall_status: Partially fulfilled; complete city beneficiary allocations and longitudinal research panel are not established.

requirements.request: City × award × original activity × observed quarter
requirements.available: National: 7,225 administering-city rows and 19,140 responsible-city rows; Texas: 0 and 1,220. The two roles overlap. An independent selected sample adds 4,440 QPR activity-quarter observations and 297 report snapshots; six Cook County activity scopes explicitly name five municipalities.
requirements.remaining: These are government relationships, not beneficiary-city allocations. Unobserved quarters are missing; subunit boundary coverage does not establish funding. The QPR sample is selective and the six named places are scopes, not beneficiary funding splits.

requirements.available: All 128,382 national and 6,518 Texas source rows preserve the five signed quarterly financial measures, IDs and period. Independent QPR budgets and cumulative values retain source pages and vintages.
requirements.remaining: F31 has no compatible city/activity allocation history. QPR allocated activity budget can include program income; it is not initial grant award or borough allocation.

requirements.request: Award start, disaster/year and DR/MIT/NDR cohort
requirements.available: Original IDs, reported disaster/year and cohort travel with exports. Initial execution verified for 28 of 206 national awards, plus supplementary QPR-only Joplin; no Texas award start verified.
requirements.remaining: 178 national dates are unverified or unresolved, including Dauphin conflicting date labels. Grant year, disaster date and later effective-date snapshots are not substituted.

requirements.request: Six cumulative E/allocation and E/obligation outcomes at Q4/Q12/Q20
requirements.available: 65 QPRs / 27 awards: 2,631 approved activity E/O and 2,698 activity E/allocated-budget values. Whole-grant E/O: 23 at Q4, 23 at Q12, 11 at Q20; E/allocation for Moore and Minot Q4 only. Joplin is supplementary to the national F31 panel. Exact eligibility and denominators are exported.
requirements.remaining: F31 opening cumulative histories are unreconciled; its six certified outcomes remain blank. Q1 is the execution calendar quarter and may be partial; horizons are not exact anniversaries.

requirements.available: 16 named categories and explicit exclusions; 16,741 national and 990 Texas category-quarter rows across overlapping roles.
requirements.remaining: Unresolved or outside-scope source types stay separate; listed QPR activities are not necessarily complete category totals.

requirements.available: 32,330 places; all 964 financial-place identities linked to 2020–2024 ACS estimates and 90% MOEs.
requirements.remaining: Suppressed/open-ended estimates remain flagged. Contemporary boundaries and ACS windows are not historical award-time controls.

requirements.available: 2024 finance: 3,843 places / 283 financial links; March 2025 employment: 2,855 places / 234 financial links.
requirements.remaining: Sample/imputation flags retained. Municipality-wide benchmarks are not CDBG staffing, quarterly capacity or accurate individual-government time series.

requirements.available: 964 city polygons: 889 NFHL mapped and 75 unmapped; NLCD land cover and LCMS modeled land use for all 964.
requirements.remaining: NFHL is regulatory hazard, not flood occurrence. NLCD is cover; LCMS is modeled use, not zoning. Full-boundary versus valid-raster-cell denominators and vintages are explicit.

requirements.available: 300 listed activities in NYC Sandy Q4/Q12/Q20 QPRs: 30 single-borough, 1 multi-borough, 5 citywide, 264 unresolved. All five borough reference polygons are selectable.
requirements.remaining: Only one award and three periods. No money split across boroughs, no office-address inference, and Q20 is unapproved. Q12 listed activity sums do not reconcile to whole-report totals.

requirements.available: 2025 land-clipped state, county/parish, place, subdivision and 8 consolidated-city layers; 2022/2026 government listings; searchable tables and filtered/full CSV downloads.
requirements.remaining: Boundary is not government identity or funded location. School/special-district service polygons and tribal/territorial government inventories are outside this supplied scope. National and Texas snapshots must not be added.

requirements.available: 40 municipal awards, 21 attempted index pages (19 retrieved), 1,030 inventory entries, source-specific period/status/hash checks. A further 240 indexed QPRs were retrieved, 236 validated. Offline MiniLM plus exact IDs and original-page validation.
requirements.remaining: Many non-horizon quarters and amendment bodies remain unread; unlinked/dynamic archives can be missed. A missing portal filename is not proof of absent records. No exhaustive-search or complete-panel claim.
